parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description:
The domain name of the website.
> The domain name must have a website forwarding rule configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the hour or on the minute.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The number of entries to return.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description:
The region of the service. Valid values:
- **cn**: the Chinese mainland.
- **cn-hongkong**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
> The value must be on the hour or on the minute.
